chart.caption: This chart shows flow revenue as a share of your total store revenue across the last 12 months. Because it measures flows against every euro the store takes, it isolates flow performance from the store's own demand swings, so a rising share reflects the channel working harder rather than a busy sales month.

heartbeat.title: Why the program keeps compounding
heartbeat.body_html:
No A/B tests concluded this month, so there is no new winning learning to report. That is worth being straight about, because the value of the testing program does not depend on any single month. Every win we bank stays live and keeps paying out permanently, while a test that does not beat control costs nothing and simply reverts. That asymmetry means the flows compound in your favour over time regardless of the strike rate in any given cycle.

What August proves instead is the durability of the work already banked: with per-email value holding at 0.300 EUR and flows recovering to nearly a fifth of total store revenue, the optimisations we have locked in continue to earn without further input. The testing engine is one of the most comprehensive automated flow-testing setups in the industry, and it resumes concluding tests as fresh variants reach significance.

narrative.html: Flows generated 38,453 EUR, up 65.8% on the prior month. That is the channel we run day and night, and it recovered strongly after the summer dip, carrying 19.4% of total store revenue versus 14.8% in July.

Revenue per email held steady at 0.300 EUR (0.308 last month). The big revenue jump came from healthy volume and demand rather than a drop in per-email quality, which means the growth is built on solid ground.

Flows are the most efficient per-email channel we run, earning 0.300 EUR per email against 0.071 EUR from campaigns, a 4.2x difference. Campaigns are the second lever we operate: across 10 sends they added the remaining share, with flows contributing 77% of total email revenue. The two work together, flows for efficiency and campaigns for reach.

Deliverability stayed clean: unsubscribes at 0.736% of delivered and spam complaints at just 0.015%. Both sit in healthy territory, which protects inbox placement and keeps every euro of flow revenue flowing.

monthly.title_sub: Flows delivered 38,453 EUR in August, up 65.8% on July, and lifted their share of total store revenue back to 19.4%.
